results.notes: One-page summaries of Alberta Education and Childcare Assurance Measures 2025 results for each public, separate and francophone school authority. Each summary includes the current year results, as well as results for the previous year, a three-year rolling average, and provincial summary results for comparison. The Alberta  Education and Childcare Assurance Measures provide school boards with a consistent way to measure their success and assess progress using a broad spectrum of measures. Reporting results allows Albertans to see how their school authority is performing and ensures that the entire education system is open and accountable.
